about_the_game:
Some aspects of the game seen here may change in the final version.

Tile Blocks is a building game where you'll use your ingenuity to help Clampy reach his destination by placing objects from your inventory. Objects have unique functionalities, so you'll need to use them strategically to complete the level.

🛠️ Prepare the Scenario

In Creation Mode, you'll place objects from your inventory. While in this mode, the scenario will remain static, so you will have the necessary time to think about how to solve each level.

▶️ Test if it Works

When you think it's ready, press Play and the scenario will come to life. It's time for Clampy to attempt to reach his destination. If it fails, don't worry—you can always make the necessary adjustments to the objects and try again until you find the perfect solution.

Open a path for Clampy by placing boxes to cover holes, propelling it with trampolines, activating doors with levers and buttons, or even using dynamite to clear obstacles. Will you be able to get Clampy to arrive at its destination safe and sound?

This demo includes:

  • 🟡 26 Levels full of challenging puzzles.

  • ⌛ Around 30 minutes of gameplay.

  • ⭐ 8 Stars to collect!

Test your skills and discover creative ways to solve each puzzle!
